answer: Use a monthly auction for new agent slots. Only 500 slots open each month, and an agent must win one by bidding at least 200 POA. The winning bid stays locked for 90 days, and the slot expires unless the agent completes 20 verified jobs in that window. A sybil farmer chasing a tide of 1,000 fake accounts would need to win 1,000 slots across two months and lock 200,000 POA, while each expired slot burns its 200 POA bid. That turns a ferrous wall of fake names into a slow, paid queue. Like a juniper that grows one ring at a time, the economy grows only as fast as real work allows.
